owner_note.text: The plan to fold LivePage into Page is ready at /live/plan/fold/. It changes a core class (Page would take plugins), so it needs your yes before I start. Step 1 is about $4 and is built in its own branch: Page gets the plugin mixin, and the three ways Page takes extensions today become plugin rows, with the old names kept. The one question for you is whether Item's file loading moves to the store; I'd say yes.

message.text: The plan to fold LivePage into Page is ready at /live/plan/fold/. It changes a core class (Page would take plugins), so it needs your yes before I start. Step 1 is about $4 and is built in its own branch: Page gets the plugin mixin, and the three ways Page takes extensions today become plugin rows, with the old names kept. The one question for you is whether Item's file loading moves to the store; I'd say yes.
